scripts.dev: bash -c 'set -a && source .env.local && set +a && exec docker compose -p pharma-demo --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build -d'
scripts.dev:down: bash -c 'set -a && source .env.local && set +a && exec docker compose -p pharma-demo --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.dev.yml down'
scripts.dev:logs: bash -c 'set -a && source .env.local && set +a && exec docker compose -p pharma-demo --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f'
scripts.docs:dev: npm run build:cross-ref && npm --prefix website start
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:cross-ref && npm --prefix website run build
scripts.test:docs: npm run check:frontmatter && npm run check:ids && npm run check:certainty && npm run check:cross-ref && npm run check:portal-excludes && npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:links && npm run docs:build && npm run check:portal-excludes
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test:apps: npm run api:test && npm run web:test
scripts.e2e:build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3121 npm --prefix apps/web run build
